newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway c.bank says sold 1.17 bln NOK Nov 6-8. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Norway c.bank says sold 1.17 bln NOK Nov 6-8. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Thursday it sold a net 1.17 billion crowns Wednesday through Friday last week.
The statement gave no explanation but analysts say the bank has been selling crowns to rein in the Norwegian crown and keep it stable.
On Wednesday last week, the bank cut key interest rates to keep the crown from appreciating too much.
The crown stood at 101.24 on the reverse ECU index at 1100gmt, slightly weaker than when the interest rate cuts were announced.
The bank has sold a net 69.03 billion crowns so far this year.
